packageRules.description: pnpm itself is updated through packageManager / .tool-versions, not as a devDependency, so the dev-deps group never caught it: it got its own PR, no schedule, re-run on every rebase (32 factory CI runs in a day, 2026-10-07). Minor/patch ride the Monday group; majors still arrive alone.
pnpm 11.12.0 self-installer regression breaks pnpm/action-setup in CI (integrity/undefined crash). Skip only that version; other pnpm updates allowed.

Block TypeScript major bumps. TS7 ships the native (Go) compiler, whose JS API shim lacks getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile — nest/tsc-based build toolchains crash on it. Re-enable deliberately once the toolchain supports TS7.
